experiments.carry_reason: The event's costings end before the population's first year. The measure is a permanent change of level whose last costing year is steady state, so later years compare with that year, scaled to the run year's base.
experiments.note: Takes the original 3pp surcharge off the additional-dwellings scale, keeping Autumn Budget 2024's further 2pp: from 2025-26 the scale becomes the main scale plus 2pp (2%, 4%, 7%, 12%, 14%) instead of plus 5pp. 2024-25 is left out because its main scale carries the Growth Plan relief for part of the year.
sources: Finance Act 2016 s. 128 and Sch. 4A FA 2003
Autumn Budget 2024 Table 5.1 (the 2pp increase from 31 October 2024)
